name: TyDiQA-GoldP
description: TyDi QA Gold Passage (GoldP) is a multilingual question answering benchmark where questions were written by information-seeking humans in 11 typologically diverse languages. Unlike SQuAD translations, questions are originally written in each language. The GoldP task provides a gold passage and requires extracting an answer span.
reputation: High-quality multilingual QA benchmark with typologically diverse languages; published at TACL 2020; used as key benchmark for multilingual LLMs
notes: Published at TACL 2020. Note: tydiqa.json exists but the GoldP task variant is distinct. 11 languages: Arabic, Bengali, Finnish, Indonesian, Japanese, Kiswahili, Korean, Russian, Telugu, Thai, and English. Questions are independently written in each language (not translated). GoldP task: given gold passage, extract answer. Full task also requires passage retrieval. Standard benchmark for multilingual LLMs.
